name: league-3-page
js: for (const d of document.querySelectorAll('details')) { const t=d.querySelector('summary')?.textContent.trim()||''; if (t.startsWith('Ladder')||t.startsWith('Upcoming fixtures')) d.open=true; } [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,div')].find(e=>e.textContent.trim()==='Danger zone')?.closest('section')?.remove();
